g.text: ENGINEERING CANDIDATE — NOT QUALIFIED FOR ACTUATION

g.desc: ENGINEERING CANDIDATE — NOT QUALIFIED FOR ACTUATION

g.text: HW_KILL_N: local 3.3 V open-drain/contact-to-ground boundary only; no harness/12 V direct connection.

g.desc: HW_KILL_N: local 3.3 V open-drain/contact-to-ground boundary only; no harness/12 V direct connection.

g.text: U806 monitors divided 5V independently of regulator PG. Fault release never substitutes for a fresh ARM edge.

g.desc: U806 monitors divided 5V independently of regulator PG. Fault release never substitutes for a fresh ARM edge.

g.text: C801..C804 at U801..U804; C807 at U806. Dynamic brownout/partial-power tests remain required.

g.desc: C801..C804 at U801..U804; C807 at U806. Dynamic brownout/partial-power tests remain required.

g.text: 3.3 V logic only. Hardware faults asynchronously clear enable; recovery requires a fresh ARM rising edge.

g.desc: 3.3 V logic only. Hardware faults asynchronously clear enable; recovery requires a fresh ARM rising edge.

g.text: Ignition OC joins HW_KILL_N through R6500. Per-load inhibition lives on driver sheets.

g.desc: Ignition OC joins HW_KILL_N through R6500. Per-load inhibition lives on driver sheets.

g.text: 64.288 ms nominal watchdog is a backup CPU monitor, NOT a coil dwell/current limiter.

g.desc: 64.288 ms nominal watchdog is a backup CPU monitor, NOT a coil dwell/current limiter.
